terminals.name: mcp-server
terminals.command: cd src/mcp_server && PATH="$HOME/.local/bin:$PATH" uv run python mcp_server.py --transport http --host 0.0.0.0 --port 9000 --no-auth
terminals.description: MACAE MCP tool server (FastMCP) on http://localhost:9000/mcp. Fully self-contained; no Azure required.

terminals.name: backend-api
terminals.description: Backend FastAPI service on http://localhost:8000 (docs at /docs). Boots with placeholders; real Azure secrets take precedence when set.

terminals.name: frontend
terminals.description: Vite dev server for the React frontend on http://localhost:3001. Calls the backend at http://localhost:8000/api.
